{{Attr|Bloated}} (Variable) }} __TOC__ ==Description== The '''Cat''' was an enemy that appeared in [[Pls Donate]] as part of the [[Tower Defense Simulator x PLS DONATE Event]]. It had a high amount of health while also being quite fast, with only the [[Guest]] being faster. It also had 25% defense, [[Stun Immunity]] and [[Freeze Immunity]]. On some waves, it could spawn as a [[Hidden (Attribute)|Hidden]] or [[Bloated]] enemy. Additionally, the [[Corrupted Haz3mn]] could summon them as [[Bloated]]. ==Appearance== The '''Cat''' was a black cat with purple eyes and a purple tail. ==Strategy== *Early game towers like the [[Crook Boss]], [[Militant]] or [[Military Base]] can be useful against it, though towers with high DPS like the [[Minigunner]], [[Mercenary Base]] or [[Engineer]] can also be useful. **The [[Military Base]] and [[Mercenary Base]] can be especially useful, as its collision damage bypasses defense. The [[Crook Boss]] also can do that with its goons, though their main source of damage is their guns. *As this enemy spawns in hordes, AOE towers like the [[Pyromancer]], [[Mortar]] or [[Electroshocker]] can be useful against them. **The [[Pyromancer]] and [[Electroshocker]] can also be useful at reducing its defense, though as it is quite low this is not necessary. ***Freeze defense dropping towers cannot be used, as it has the [[Freeze Immunity]]. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Animations}} Catwalk.gif|Walking animation (13 November 2024 – 4 December 2024) {{GalleryHeader|Icons}} PlsDonateUpdateIcon.png|'''Cat''' on the game icon. PlsDonateBpBoostIcon.png|'''Cat''' on the game icon. {{GalleryHeader|Thumbnails}} PLSDONATE.png|'''Cat''' on the game thumbnail. PlsDonateBattlepassBoostThumbnail.png|'''Cat''' on the game thumbnail. {{GalleryHeader|Promotional Images}} PlsDonateThumbnailClean.png|'''Cat''' on a promotional image. {{GalleryHeader|Promotional Videos}} PLS DONATE Trailer - Tower Defense Simulator|'''Cat''' on a promotional video. {{GalleryHeader|Cutscenes}} Pls Donate Cutscene|'''Cat''' In the [[Pls Donate]] Cutscene. {{GalleryHeader|Renders}} PlsDonateEventIconClean.png|'''Cat''' on a render. }} ==Trivia== *This enemy's appearance is based on the cat seen on {{RLinkU|haz3mn|Hazem}}'s Roblox avatar. **Because of this, it could also be seen on the [[Corrupted Haz3mn]]. *The '''Cat''''s voice is from [https://www.roblox.com/users/31164652/profile Enthrallist]'s cat but pitched up. ==Update History== *'''13 November 2024''' - [[v1.41.0]] **'''Cat''' added. **{{Bug}} [[Jester]]'s defense dropping does not reduce '''Cat's''' defense. *'''4 December 2024''' - [[v1.44.0]] **'''Cat''' removed. {{PlsDonate|[[Trader]]|Wave 7|Cat|Wave 8|[[Breaker2]]|Wave 11}} {{ZombieNavBox}}
